subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about funded-account acquisition for your wallet. Wallet adoption here jumped to 70 percent of South Africans paying digitally in 2024, from 46 percent a year earlier (Stitch via ECR 2025), so the install spike is real and the question is which of those loads actually funds. That is where source quality decides your cost, because payment-app economics run below the 2.8:1 LTV-to-CAC line at most acquirers (First Page Sage 2026). Yoco-grade quality comes from validating the load itself. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: wallet-adoption surge (sourced) + 2.8:1 LTV-to-CAC benchmark band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN fintech wallet: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior in first sentence; fresh angle = timely wallet-adoption surge (70 percent in 2024 from 46 percent, Stitch via ECR 2025, verified from parent sources) plus the verified payment-app LTV-to-CAC band (below 2.8:1 at most acquirers, First Page Sage 2026); names Yoco from brand_candidates as the quality bar (rotated for stage 2); no MobUpps figure this stage; exactly 1 question mark; native en; no sign-off; no em dash; no X-not-Y; no hedge before a number; market context sourced with verified URLs carried from the parent.
